# ScrollBehavior

`Flare.Components.ScrollBehavior`

How the browser should animate a programmatic scroll.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Auto` | `0` | Follow the CSS scroll-behavior in effect for the element. |
| `Smooth` | `1` | Animate to the target. |
| `Instant` | `2` | Jump to the target with no animation. |
